interpretation.pure_model_baseline: A plain-recap base model can already create plausible sequences; one target scored 73, but the three-work median was 65.
interpretation.rich_state_effect: The largest incremental gain was A1-A0 +11 median, indicating that a richer, correctly maintained N-1 narrative state is a major asset.
interpretation.los_representation_grammar_effect: B-A1 +4 median supports added value from Literary OS structured state/THICK/explicit Sequence grammar, though this contrast is not a pure grammar-only ablation.
interpretation.hierarchy_effect: C-B +2 median is positive but below the preregistered +3 gate, so the prior +5 hierarchy gain did not fully replicate.
interpretation.retrieval_effect: D-C 0 median; current retrieval did not add measurable value in this sample.
interpretation.failure_mode: In 드림 EP09, Literary OS overcommitted to an active dangerous-match thread and missed the canonical escalation choice: license monopoly cancels the event itself. More information can harden the wrong center if episode-level axis selection is wrong.

claims_not_granted: formal causal superiority over a base GPT
next_priority: episode-axis selection / escalation-level prediction / active-thread suppression, then rerun with independent blind scoring and larger fresh target set
